411 section9 requires private-final state lock, not public this/class monitor. Window protects previous/start as one transition; clock captures supplied ticks/UTC and commits only after valid context; poller serializes supplied time/input/action with gap/commit state. ReentrantLock suggestion is not a project requirement. Internal order is poller->clock then observation/window/lifecycle, no reverse calls in reviewed pure closure. Callback duration, actual collectors/stop authority are outer responsibilities, not a locally bounded-runtime claim. Finite standalone serialization tests validate this source only.

Null-result NPE also propagates and cannot commit later elapsed. Independent exception identity/no-call/next-gap tests cover intended source contract; no actual external failure recovery or all implicit JVM errors inferred.
